en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a quiet street beside a fenced property with long, low buildings and a small tower-like dome. On the main façade, large painted German words advertise a sparkling-wine cellar called "Sektkellerei Niederlößnitz." A stone wall and wooden picket fence run along the street, with telegraph poles and tall poplar trees lining the road. In the background are additional residential-style buildings and more trees, suggesting a semi-rural wine-growing town.
